customer_message.subject: Request for help contesting termination of tenancy at Hofackerstrasse 7, Olten
customer_message.body: Dear Legal Expenses Team, I am writing through your portal because I need help contesting the termination of my tenancy at Hofackerstrasse 7, 4600 Olten, a 3.5-room flat. My landlord, Peter Ammann, a private landlord, has ended my lease because he says I am in rent arrears. He puts the outstanding amount at about CHF 6600. I want to contest the termination and ask that the tenancy be extended, because moving out by the end date would cause me serious hardship. Finding a comparable flat in Olten within a short time is very difficult, and I am currently dealing with a health problem that makes moving and organising a new home especially hard for me. I would like your team to check whether the termination is valid and to advise me on the steps needed to request an extension from the landlord or, if necessary, from the conciliation authority. I can provide my rental contract, my rent payment records and a medical certificate. Please contact me through the portal or by phone. I would appreciate a response as soon as possible, as the end date is approaching. Kind regards, Robin Clarke
